newsitem.title: JAPAN: Hosiden bid-only on Philips tie-up news.
newsitem.headline: Hosiden bid-only on Philips tie-up news.

text.p: Shares in Hosiden Corp were bid-only on Friday morning after the company said it was in the final stage of talks with Philips Electronics NV on a tie-up in the production of liquid crystal displays (LCDs), brokers said.
As of 0050 GMT, the shares were bid-only at 1,110 yen, after they closed on Wednesday at 1,050 yen. The Tokyo market was closed on Thursday for a national holiday.
Hosiden said on Friday that it was in the final stage of negotiations with Philips on a tie-up to produce LCDs, but declined to give details.
Hosiden makes parts for consumer electronics products.
The Japanese economic daily Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Thursday that the two companies had already agreed to jointly produce LCDs in Japan.
They will form a joint venture next April and use Hosiden's existing plants to jointly produce LCDs, the paper said.
